builds.report:
The commit is a2f316d on branch build/mm-p1-fix1, on top of f1c4867. It is not pushed, and the commit gate allowed it.

Files changed:
- src/main/inference.ts: only readStreamed and its doc comment. On the OpenAI-shaped plain-JSON path, after readBoundedJson, a top-level `error` that is not null now throws PROVIDER_STREAM_ERROR before ChatSchema. A body with `"error": null` is still accepted.
- tests/provider-stream.test.ts: 10 new tests, appended.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: one sentence at the end of the paragraph that begins "The September 30 reconciliation".

What happened to each finding:
- BRK-3 / MM-P1-SPEC-9: fixed. Two tests use E-25's error object from capture line 445. One checks that a non-null error fails the call; the other checks that `"error": null` still completes. A grep confirmed no existing test sends a 200 plain-JSON body with a non-null error. Only the 400/413/422 refusal bodies carry one, and those never reach readStreamed.
- MUT-2 + MUT-9: closed. One test runs E-20's stream without [DONE], so it ends on the stop+usage chunk with no blank line, and expects complete with usage. A second test reads E10_BASIC as captured, unterminated, and expects the last event to keep the name message_stop.
- MUT-6: closed. E-20 with every `data: ` written `data:`, including `data:[DONE]`, still completes.
- MUT-8: closed. E-20, then [DONE], then a `data: not json` line, sent on a stream that is never closed. The call completes and the stream is cancelled.
- MUT-12: closed. Every E-20 chunk (capture lines 1143-1165) carries `"error": null` and the call still completes.
- MUT-13: closed.
  - An empty `event:` line gives event undefined.
  - A colon-less `data` line counts as an empty data value. One such line yields no event. Two such lines make the data "\n", which fails with PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE. That is what the current code gives, and it matches the WHATWG HTML grammar, which is not in the corpus.
- MUT-14: closed. readSse with maxBytes equal to the body's size reads all 11 events. One byte less throws PROVIDER_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE.

Guard proofs: I applied each mutation, ran both stream test files, then restored the file. Every mutation turned exactly its named test red; S14 also turned the event-name test red, as expected. Before the fix, only the plain-JSON error test was red. The other nine passed as pure pins.

Checks after the change, all verified: typecheck exit 0, lint exit 0, and the four test files passed 138/138. I did not run the full Linux suite; I expect it to match the baseline.

Deviations:
- All tests went into tests/provider-stream.test.ts, where the E-20, E-10 and E-25 fixtures and their check against the captures already live. tests/provider-transport.test.ts is unchanged.
- The error check is inline in readStreamed rather than a helper shared with the accumulator, so that the import line of inference.ts is not touched.

Risks:
- The `!= null` rule is now in two places, provider-stream.ts and readStreamed, and can drift apart.
- A plain-JSON failure is reported as PROVIDER_STREAM_ERROR, a name that says "stream". This is as the brief asked.
- Mutation S03 (any truthy `error` counting as an error) is still not pinned. It was not in this brief.

builds.report:
Commit 11695fd on build/mm-p1-fix2, parent f1c4867. Not pushed. Commit gate result: "research gate: allow".

Files changed (4 files, +65/-12):
- src/main/ollama-locality.ts: readStatus now sends `cache: 'no-store'`. It also runs `if (signal.aborted) { cancel(); return false; }` right after the abort listener is registered. The redirect comment and the defence-in-depth comment are reworded.
- tests/ollama-locality.test.ts: 5 new tests. The constants are pinned inside the timing test, and that test's comment is reworded. The wire test is renamed so it claims only what Node's fetch can show.
- tests/application.test.ts: the LOCAL_MODEL_UNVERIFIED test now checks the whole message against the spec text.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: one sentence added to the privacy paragraph.

Electron check for BRK-1 (Electron 44.4.5 under xvfb, cache.cjs in scratchpad/el-fix2, bundle built from this worktree):
- Before (f1c4867 bundle): the max-age=600, Expires and Last-Modified-only cases all passed step 2 ("ok") with only 1 status request reaching the fake Ollama.
- After: all 5 header cases refuse step 2 with LOCAL_MODEL_UNVERIFIED, and the fake Ollama sees 2 requests in each.
- Output is saved in before.txt and after.txt in that folder.

Deviations:
- In the BRK-2 test, the server holds back its headers until the check has already refused. The breaker used a fixed 5.5 s timer instead. Holding them makes the order certain, so the test is not timing-sensitive on a slow runner.
- I also pinned STATUS_MAX_BYTES and proved it red with a mutation (G5b).
- I renamed the existing wire test, which the review listed as optional.

Risks:
- The late-headers test adds about 6 s to the suite.
- The late-headers fix was checked only with Node's fetch, not in Electron.
- The exact-init test will fail on any future option added to the request init. That is deliberate.
